blurb: Guests can visit two taprooms in Neenah and Wauwatosa to enjoy over 20 Lion's Tail brews on tap along with select wines, liquor, soda, and other non-alcoholic beverages. Food options include carry-in, on-site food trucks, and frozen pizzas or pretzels. The brewery hosts various events such as music bingo, trivia, and food truck gatherings.
extraNote: Well-behaved and leashed dogs are welcome on the patio and Biergarten · Carry-in food allowed; on-site food trucks and frozen pizzas available · Neenah Taproom at 116 S. Commercial St., Neenah, WI 54956 or Wauwatosa Taproom at 8520 W North Ave, Wauwatosa, WI 53226
